en.title: Godzilla Minus Zero Roars Past $6.7M in Previews, Eyes Massive Opening
en.summary: The King of the Monsters is back with a vengeance, as 'Godzilla Minus Zero' stomped its way to $6.7 million in Thursday night previews. Early industry projections suggest a colossal opening weekend, potentially dwarfing its predecessor.
en.body:
The roar of **Godzilla** is once again echoing through cinemas, and this time, it's bringing a tidal wave of box office success with it. **Godzilla Minus Zero**, the highly anticipated sequel to the critically acclaimed **Godzilla Minus One**, has officially clawed its way to $6.7 million in preview screenings across North America. This impressive debut figure, reported by Variety, sets the stage for what is shaping up to be a monstrous opening weekend.

Industry forecasts are predicting a staggering $30 million debut for the Japanese blockbuster, a figure that would more than double the $11.4 million earned by its predecessor during its own opening weekend back in 2023. While Deadline reported a slightly different preview number around $6 million, the overall sentiment remains clear: audiences are eager to witness Godzilla's destructive power once more. This strong performance places **Godzilla Minus Zero** firmly ahead of other new releases vying for attention this weekend.

## A Legacy of Roars

The success of **Godzilla Minus One** was a global phenomenon, earning critical adoration and even an Academy Award for Best Visual Effects. It resonated with audiences not just for its spectacular monster action, but for its deeply human story set against the backdrop of post-war Japan. The bar was set incredibly high for **Godzilla Minus Zero**, and these preview numbers suggest that director **Takashi Yamazaki** and his team have once again delivered a film that captivates.

Pre-release tracking had already hinted at a significant box office draw, with projections placing the opening weekend in the $25–35 million range in the United States and Canada. This puts **Godzilla Minus Zero** in contention to surpass major Hollywood entries like **Godzilla vs. Kong** (2021), which opened to $31.6 million, and even approach the massive $47.7 million opening of **Godzilla: King of the Monsters** (2019). The film currently boasts an impressive 89% score on the Tomatometer, based on 89 reviews, indicating widespread critical approval.

## The Kaiju Craze Continues

For fans, this isn't just another monster movie; it's a testament to the enduring power of the **Godzilla** franchise and the artistry that can be brought to its modern iterations. The global community has embraced the blend of breathtaking special effects, compelling narratives, and the sheer awe-inspiring presence of Godzilla. The strong preview numbers are a clear indicator that the passion for this iconic kaiju remains as potent as ever, with audiences worldwide eager to dive back into its universe.

## What's Next

With its robust preview performance and overwhelmingly positive critical reception, **Godzilla Minus Zero** is poised for a dominant weekend at the box office. Audiences can continue to flock to theaters to experience the latest chapter in Godzilla's saga, with further box office figures expected to be released throughout the weekend.
